direction.text: Direction: "Floor ledger". Warm paper ground, ink type, hairline rules, one blue for data and actions. Machine states use green / amber / red / grey, always with a label or shape too. Type: IBM Plex Sans Condensed for display, IBM Plex Sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono only for codes and numbers, Noto Sans Bengali for Bangla. Light first: supervisors read tablets on a bright floor. All numbers in the app screens are sample data.
